finding: WORST MISSING SCREEN IN THIS MODULE — nothing anywhere authors a variant, so 'pick a variant' (one of the five named component jobs) is unreachable end to end, and two shipped controls are permanently inert because of it.
evidence: ComponentManager.setVariantProperties (ComponentManager.ts:311), addVariant (:320), updateVariant (:330), removeVariant (:347) have ZERO callers outside __tests__ (grep across src). CreateComponentModal.tsx:227 promises 'You can configure variant values after creation' and board 1170:4777 draws that exact sentence; no board and no screen does it. Consequences, both verified: (a) useComponentsState.ts:376-381 — handleSwapVariant bails with 'This component has no variants defined.' because component.variants is always empty, so the variant-picker modal at ComponentsTab.tsx:340-381 can never open; (b) VariantSection.tsx:71-82 — the inspector's variant <Select> (:121-135, board 160:2) calls handleVariantChange, which does variants.find(...) on [] and returns without doing anything.
fix: Build a variant-authoring screen on the component detail drill-in: list variantProperties, add/rename/remove a variant per property-value combination, capture overrides. Engine CRUD is already there and tested — this is a door, not a feature.

finding: The inspector's variant dropdown is a dead control in the shipped product: changing it does nothing and says nothing.
evidence: VariantSection.tsx:76-81 — handleVariantChange looks the chosen value up in componentInfo.component.variants and only calls updateInstanceVariant when it finds a match; there is no else branch. component.variants is always empty for user-made components (see W-O-09), so every change is a silent no-op. The band still renders because :103 gates only the pickers on variantProperties, which CreateComponentModal.tsx:92-101 DOES write.
fix: Either build variant authoring (W-O-09) or hide the pickers when variants is empty and keep the 'COMPONENT INSTANCE' band, which is the honest state.

finding: The detail screen's variant chips change only which pill is highlighted — nothing else on the screen reads the value.
evidence: ComponentDetailScreen.tsx:106-115 declares selectedVariantValues 'State for variant selection (for preview)'; its ONLY reader is :391, the chip's own selectedValue prop (grep for selectedVariantValues in that file returns exactly lines 106 and 391). The preview box above is component.thumbnail (:281-291), a static value the chips do not touch, and no instance or master is written.
fix: Either render the selected variant into the preview, or drop the chips until W-O-09 lands. A picker whose only effect is on itself is worse than no picker.

finding: The board's large preview can never be filled: component.thumbnail has no producer anywhere in the codebase.

So every detail screen renders the 'No Preview' fallback (ComponentDetailScreen.tsx:286-290).
fix: Either produce a thumbnail at create time (rasterise the master subtree) or redraw 641:2599 with the empty-preview state as the default, so the board stops promising a picture the product cannot make.

finding: The board's PROPERTIES section (Image → instance swap, Title → text, Price → text · CMS bound) has no code at all — a user cannot see or set a component's exposed properties.

finding: The board's USED ON list (Menu 12 instances ›, Home 4 ›, Catering 2 ›) has no code, the server procedure that would answer it has no caller, and the three chevron rows are dead on the board too — a second census miss.

finding: The board's two footer actions and the shipped screen's four actions are disjoint sets: 'Edit main component' and 'Detach all' exist nowhere in code; Insert / Duplicate / Update / Delete exist nowhere on the board.

finding: The loading board is unreachable for a fixable reason, and the EMPTY board is shown in its place — a user with saved components is told 'No components yet' until storage resolves.
evidence: ComponentManager.ts:94-96 fires initialize() without awaiting or storing the promise; loadComponentsFromStorage awaits loadComponents(projectId) at :124 and only then emits COMPONENT_LIST_UPDATED (:131-133). The panel meanwhile reads the Map synchronously and sets isLoaded=true on its first pass (useComponentsState.ts:144-151), so the skeleton at ComponentsTab.tsx:237-243 renders for at most one commit and the components.length===0 branch (ComponentsTab.tsx:135) wins — that branch draws board 1138:13394. boards.json already records 778:4173 as 'unreachable-loading-state-cannot-be-entered'; this is the mechanism, and it is a bug, not a design decision.
fix: Gate the skeleton on the engine's load having completed (first COMPONENT_LIST_UPDATED, or an awaited ready promise on ComponentManager), not on a flag set synchronously. Then 778:4173 becomes reachable as drawn.

finding: Detaching through the Components panel drops a refusal silently — the same action through the inspector reports it. Same consequence, two answers, depending on the door.

finding: The record picker has no board, and the boards wire the exact shortcut the code calls the old broken flow — a builder following these boards rebuilds a fixed bug.
evidence: Binding needs THREE picks. bindToField is called from exactly one place, handleSelectRecord (BindingPopover.tsx:158-175); picking a field only loads the record list (handleSelectField, :144-156). The code says why at :142-144: 'Field then record: a single-element binding needs BOTH a field and a specific record (itemId), otherwise resolveBinding has nothing to read and always returns the fallback (the old flow bound with itemId=undefined).' The record level is rendered at :275-306 ('Record' MenuLabel, back-row, per-record MenuItems). The boards go 1719:8443 (collections) → 1719:8450 (fields) → hotspot/state 'bound' → 1719:8421 (bound · inspector) — field straight to bound, no record step. Screenshot of 1719:8450 confirms it ends at the 8 field rows.
fix: Duplicate 1719:8450 as 'Ecommerce · bind · popover · records': back-row '← {field name}', 'Record' label, one row per record labelled by the collection's displayField with the record status as the right-hand kbd (BindingPopover.tsx:294-305). Re-point the 'bound' hotspot to fire from a record row, not a field row.

finding: The empty branch of the bind flow has no board, and the copy the product shows there sends the user to a command-palette-only door instead of the visible one on the rail.
evidence: BindingPopover.tsx:288-291 renders 'No records yet. Add records via the command palette → “Manage CMS Records”.' This is the state of any user who took 'Skip for now' on the setup modal or created the collection without sample data. CMS_MANAGE_RECORDS has exactly one emitter in the whole repo — useCanvasCommandPalette.ts:171 (grep) — while the door a user can actually see is the Content rail tab, which lists collections and drills into records (ContentTab.tsx:92, :171, :230). No board in 1779:6 draws either the empty branch or the records modal.
fix: Board the empty branch off 1719:8450, and change the copy to name Content, which is on the rail. Pointing a beginner at a command palette to finish a flow they started from a drag-and-drop block is the wrong door.

finding: 'Skip for now' has no board and no way back: the block is already on the canvas showing placeholder data, and the offer never returns for the rest of the session.
evidence: CollectionSetupModal.tsx:57-60 — handleSkip calls onSkip?.() then onClose(); StudioModals.tsx:224 passes onSkip={onCloseCollectionSetup}, so skipping only closes. The product block was inserted BEFORE the modal opened (the modal is raised from ELEMENT_INSERTED, useComposerInit.ts:758), and it ships placeholder content — an Unsplash photo and '$0.00' (ProductCard.tsx:23, :31). hasPromptedForCollectionRef is claimed before the await and never reset (useComposerInit.ts:725, :737-738), so nothing re-offers the setup. Board 1719:8391 draws the 'Skip for now' button but has no edge from it (OUT(2) = self→137:2, hotspot/state·collec→1719:8414).
fix: Board the skipped state (product block on canvas, unbound, with a way to re-open the setup), and give the inspector or the block a 'Set up Products collection' affordance. Then wire 'Skip for now' → that board.

finding: Nothing draws or collects checkout, so the 'Add to Cart' button every Product Card ships is inert on every published site — a full cart + Stripe checkout engine sits behind a config object no editor surface can write.
evidence: ExportEngine.ts:543-546 injects generateStripeScripts(config.stripe); StripeInjector.ts:249-252 returns '' unless config.enabled && config.publishableKey. StripeConfig needs 7 fields (shared/types/project.ts:364-377: enabled, publishableKey, checkoutMode, checkoutEndpoint, successUrl, cancelUrl, currency) and a repo-wide grep for 'stripe:' outside __tests__ finds no writer. The only Stripe surface in the editor is Settings → Integrations, which renders it as status="soon" with a 'Learn More' link to stripe.com/docs and nothing else (IntegrationsScreen.tsx:31-49). The button the script would bind to is real and shipped: ProductCard.tsx:32, <button data-add-to-cart>, matched by StripeInjector.ts:207.
fix: Either board and build a Stripe settings screen that writes integrations.stripe (7 fields, plus the key-format check isValidStripePublishableKey already in StripeInjector.ts:270-272), or stop shipping an Add to Cart button in the Product Card block until it can work. Today the flow ends at 'bound', and bound is not sold.

finding: The board carries a stale bug annotation that the code has already fixed — left as is, a builder either re-fixes a fixed bug or deletes a row that is live.
evidence: The drawn note on 1719:8421 reads: 'Only the chip and the banner are live. BindingPopover's own bound row is local useState, never seeded — reselect and it is gone.' The code now seeds it: BindingPopover.tsx:82-111 reads composer.cms.bindings.getBindings(elementId), sets isBound/boundLabel from it, and re-syncs on BINDING_CREATED and BINDING_REMOVED; the file's own comment at :71-80 records the fix and names the blocker it closed (A-EC1). Per the precedence rule, behaviour follows the CODE contract.
fix: Strike the note. The bound row with its Unbind button is live (BindingPopover.tsx:205-224).

finding: Two controls the popover always renders are missing from the field-level board.
evidence: BindingPopover.tsx:311-325 renders '+ Create Collection' outside the Menu, so it is present at every level; screenshot of 1719:8443 (collections) draws it, screenshot of 1719:8450 (fields) does not.
